Bank clock fixed/advancing around 2026-10-14, no real bank connection
exclusions: Browser/GLM and professional security approvals are separate evidence
HTTP export, SSE and recovery branches are ticket07
Existing arithmetic 147, phase1 L01 17 and these independent cases must not be added as if overlapping work were unique coverage
